status: diagnostic replay; not closed-loop policy evaluation

source.feedback: three individual Bernoulli outcomes from each executed B2-Semi matching
source.selection_reason: Factorial artifact has aggregate expected/realized reward and observation masks but no pair-level Bernoulli success outcomes; E1 trace has the pair-level outcomes needed for a valid common-history replay. B2-Semi/UCB1 is a representative full-feedback 3x3 history, retained as a fixed source stream for both estimators.
source.source_history_limitation: All histories were generated by the original B2-Semi/UCB1 closed-loop organization; replay results are conditional on these UCB1-origin histories and are not an unbiased sample of histories generated by SW-UCB.

estimators.UCB1: existing per-pair full-history mean plus sqrt(2 log(max(2,t+1))/n)
estimators.SW-UCB: existing per-pair global-period window W=1214, xi=2.0; empirical mean over observations in [t-W,t)

replay.shared_input: For each seed, both estimators receive exactly the same observed pair/reward events at original periods; diagnostic decisions never affect subsequent input.
replay.decision_information: Estimators use only past replay events. True competence matrices are used after decision construction only to calculate MSE and expected reward/regret.
replay.mse_timing: Estimate at period t is evaluated against the competence matrix at t before period-t feedback is delivered.
replay.bonus_effect: Within each estimator and frozen history, index-matching versus mean-matching expected-regret difference is the immediate local effect of substituting index scores for empirical means; it excludes future feedback consequences.

limits: This is a diagnostic replay conditioned on an existing UCB1-generated action/feedback trajectory, not a closed-loop policy comparison.
The E1 environment has one transient competence regime followed by a return to baseline; factorial recurrent-regime pair-level outcomes were not saved and were not reconstructed.
MSE and expected decision regret are evaluated descriptively on the same frozen histories; their association does not establish general causal mediation.
The local index-versus-mean contrast identifies only the immediate decision effect on the frozen history, not future effects through altered observation acquisition.
